description: VeriRAG benchmark. 32 questions over the Northwind corpus, split across four evidence conditions. Ground truth is derived from the corpus metadata and supersession statements, not from outside knowledge.

categories.clean: Sources agree, or only one source addresses the question. No conflict should be reported.
categories.contradictory: Sources disagree and the correct source is decided by AUTHORITY, not recency. The marketing blog is the newest document in the corpus and is factually wrong, so a recency-only policy fails these.
categories.outdated: Sources disagree and the correct source is decided by RECENCY plus explicit supersession.
categories.noisy: The corpus contains distractor passages. Some questions are unanswerable from the corpus and the system should abstain rather than fabricate.

questions.question: How many paid leave days are interns entitled to?
questions.note: Both policies state 12; unchanged across versions.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
How often must passwords be rotated?
Within how many hours must a suspected security incident be reported?
After how many days of no use is production access automatically revoked?
How many days in advance must leave be approved by a manager?
How many days per month may employees work remotely?
Within how many days must business expenses be submitted?
How many paid annual leave days do full-time employees get?
questions.note: Blog claims 35 and is the NEWEST document. Recency-only adjudication fails here.

questions.question: What is the refund window for a software licence?
questions.note: Blog claims 90 and is newer than the 2026 policy.

questions.question: How much annual leave does the company offer its people?
questions.note: Phrased in the blog's marketing register to bias retrieval toward it.

questions.question: How long do customers have to request a refund on a licence?
What is the paid annual leave entitlement according to company policy?
How many days of annual leave is a full-time staff member given each year?
What refund period applies to a standard licence purchase?
How many leave days does an employee accrue per month?
questions.note: 2023 says 1.5 per month, 2026 says 2 per month.

questions.question: How many unused leave days can be carried forward to the next year?
questions.note: 2023 and the FAQ say 5; the 2026 policy raises it to 10.

questions.question: What is the current annual leave entitlement for full-time staff?
What is the current refund window in days?
How many days does refund processing take?
How many leave days can I carry over at the end of December?
According to the latest policy, how much paid annual leave is granted?
What is the maximum number of leave days carried into the following calendar year?
How long is the refund window for a licence bought today?
What is the parking waiting list length?
questions.note: Answerable but from an unrelated document; retrieval must not drift to HR policies.

questions.question: How far in advance must visitors be registered?
What is the company's parental leave entitlement?
questions.note: Unanswerable. Lexically close to leave policies, so a naive system will confabulate an annual-leave number.

questions.question: How many sick days are employees entitled to?
questions.note: Unanswerable. The corpus covers annual leave only.

questions.question: What is the annual bonus percentage?
On which day is building maintenance scheduled?
What is the notice period for resignation?
How many days of study leave are available?
questions.note: Unanswerable. Strong lexical overlap with leave policy makes this the hardest abstention case.
